text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(I've always loved running, ever since I 
was little.)
(Patter-patter-patter-patter!)

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't kick the blanket! Don't run 
under the covers! You still have a fever, 
don't you?!

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Fine, totally fine! In fact, sweating it 
out is good for your heal— —...*cough* 
*cough*, *gag*!?

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Younger Sister A
text_block_list.text: "Mooom!! Tsuu-chan is choking--!!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Ever since I was little, I wanted to 
become a strong Umamusume.)

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: It's been so looong, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Training Club Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Waah~ It's Tsuru-chan!! Is your leg okay 
now? Are you allowed to run?

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Everyone beat my record, so today 
I'm gonna overtake them all in one go...!

text_block_list.name: Training Club Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Woo-hoo! Tsuru-chan is in top form~!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (Ever since the old days, I—)

text_block_list.name: Training Club Teacher
text_block_list.text:
—Eh!? Tsurumaru collapsed!? No way—... 
Hurry, call an ambulance!!

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Am I not able to race?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
I have to give it to you straight: with 
her body as it is, continuing to compete 
in races will be... nearly impossible.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Of course, it's not entirely impossible. 
However... I must say, thriving as an 
athlete will be extremely difficult...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
It seems there are no "absolutes" in this 
world. All there is... are possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I do have proof! The doctor didn't say it 
was 'absolutely impossible'! Which means 
if I give it my all, it's not impossible—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...That might be true, but...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Maxims like 'hard work never betrays you' 
and encouragements like 'everything will 
definitely be fine'... I just couldn't 
take them at face value.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Even if you try your hardest, no matter 
how much effort you put in... ...it just 
means there are no "absolutes."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (—However, in moments like this...)

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
"Symboli Rudolf! Symboli Rudolf is making 
her move from the inside!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Symboli Rudolf! It's Rudolf! The 
undefeated Triple Crown Umamusume is now! 
Right now—...!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Symboli Rudolf has done it! The Triple 
Crown is hers! An immortal, monumental 
record!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Once she sets her mind on winning, this 
Umamusume is an absolute force!!"
(Wooooaaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —“Absolute”...

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I-It's true. Definitely! This Umamusume is 
definitely strong!

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Found it! I found it, I found it! It's 
definitely here--!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Symboli Rudolf wins! Symboli Rudolf 
stands at the pinnacle of the world!"

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
"Well, you just have to say it. With the 
'Emperor' Symboli Rudolf, victory is an 
absolute certainty."

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Hyaaah~, Rudolf-san is so strong~! She's 
so cool~~!"

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu! Miracles definitely happen! I'm 
gonna become a strong Umamusume too.

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times I get hurt! Or 
hospitalized! I'll definitely be able to 
run again. I'm gonna get waaaay stronger!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ("Absolute"! Just like Symboli Rudolf!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(That's what I came to Tracen Academy for, 
after all!!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Fuhehe... *inhale*...――

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Gooood moooorning!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Minions, surround Tsuru-chan, YEEEEES!!

text_block_list.name: Classmates & Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ooooh~~! Huuuh~~!?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(And then, I was surrounded by five girls 
who were my classmates, my friends, and my 
peers――)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Wait, why, whyy!!?? ...Pffthahaha! Hold 
on... Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Why" is MY line, DEES! Now, spill the 
secret!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on a sec, time out--!? It's not 
like... I have any secrets--

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You know how it is, right~? Before you 
know it, you've signed a contract with a 
Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ah, *that* topic!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's right! You were out on doctor's 
orders on the day of the Debut Race!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Could she have been tricked by some shady 
person while feeling woozy from being 
unwell—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, I haven't been tricked! Um, you 
see, with my current Trainer..."
"I will light your path."
"I shall illuminate your path."

"No matter what happens, I will always be 
here to support you."

"No matter what happens, I will always 
support you."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Well, one thing led to another, 
and I ended up signing a contract, you 
could say...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...All sorts of things...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It looks like there are lovely memories, 
as well as stories that need to be heard~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Shall we go for... one more round?

text_block_list.name: Spe & Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ooooh~~! Whaaat, agaaain~~!?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Hyaha, ahyahaha! Have mercy... ahyahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
And that's why I've been totally out of 
breath and exhausted since this morning!
choice_data_list: Ahaha, you two get along so well.

Ahaha, you two really get along well, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I won't deny that!! She's a beloved 
friend and a classmate, after all!

My trainee, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi, smiles 
like that before training.

However, the classmates from her year that 
she just mentioned. Those girls are—

—She is a candidate for "the strongest 
rival" in Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's eyes.

Take King Halo, the highborn lady, for 
example. Her mother was apparently an 
Umamusume who took the American racing 
world by storm.

Additionally, El Condor Pasa is highly 
praised as having the caliber to aim for 
world number one... I hear overseas plans 
are already in the works.

Speaking of top contenders, Grass Wonder 
is definitely one. And though she's 
keeping a low profile for now, Seiun Sky 
is another one we must watch closely—

Including the transfer student from 
Hokkaido, Special Week, who has yet to 
unleash her unknown potential.

In the near future, I will definitely have 
to clash with them.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...I understand, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
If I can't surpass my fellow classmate, I 
can never become a Triple Tiara Umamusume.
choice_data_list:
...That's right, you're aiming for the 
Triple Crown.

...Yeah, you're aiming for the Triple 
Crown.

text_block_list.text:
Triple Crown Umamusume. It is a title 
bestowed only upon those who conquer all 
three Classic Triple Crown races: the 
Satsuki Sho, the Japan Derby, and the 
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Because each and every one of them is a 
once-in-a-lifetime race where only 
Classic-class Umamusume can fight for the 
top."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I definitely cannot lose. I'll win, and 
just like President Rudolf—...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I'm giving it everything I've got 
today too!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Because what we're aiming for is to 
become an incredibly strong Triple Crown 
Umamusume!

Nodding along with her enthusiasm, I took 
out the training materials. At first, 
we'll tailor it to Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's 
constitution...
choice_data_list: We'll start with a light warm-up today!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Let's do this thoroughly and 
give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
50 laps or 100 laps, bring it on! 
Wrooooooooooooooar!!" || "50 laps or 100 
laps! Wrooooooooooooooar!!
choice_data_list:
O-One hundred?! Wait just a minute, 
Tsuyoshi!

O-One hundred?! Wait just a minute, 
Tsuyoshi!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Oooohhhh--!!

I tried desperately to stop her, but an 
Umamusume's legs won't be held back. She 
took off running at full speed—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Hanya... funya...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —*gasp* *cough*...

And "right" after that, I rushed to help 
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi, who had fallen to her 
knees.

And so began our days of taking on the 
Twinkle Series alongside Tsurumaru 
Tsuyoshi, an Umamusume who always gives it 
her all!
